customManagers.description: The tools pinned in environment.yml, whose versions build_tools/check_versions.py checks against their pre-commit hooks. The version ranges are changed by hand, so only the exact pins are matched.

packageRules.description: The updates are build changes in Conventional Commits, and those of the actions are CI changes, instead of the types of config:recommended.
Update the actions together, in a single pull request.
The development environment uses the minimum supported Python version, which is raised by hand.
Update the hook of each tool along with its pin in environment.yml, so that build_tools/check_versions.py passes.
The runtime dependencies installed in the hooks stay within their range in project.dependencies in pyproject.toml, which build_tools/check_versions.py checks to match.
